Scientific-caption contract across resampling outcomes. The Pogona sex-development series
experiment uses the RNA abundance layer to assess the declared genotype target contrasts ZW
with ZZ. (A) Bars retain the requested denominator for complete, partial, and abstention
outcomes. Red shows completed resamples and black outlines show requests. The analysis unit is
independent embryo; the design is stage-stratified biological-unit bootstrap. Failed resamples
are retained rather than regenerated. Six of twenty requested resamples did not complete. No
acceptance threshold is applied. The visualization is descriptive and does not establish
biological validity.
